Independent exact rational witness and second-moment recurrence
correctness.rationale: A nonzero projection of the exact rank-one sketch onto e_S recovers H_S; P_S is diagonal and the independently sampled spectral estimator gives eta=alpha(P_S)_{TT}. For each coordinate the four equiprobable environments yield gains alpha, alpha, alpha t, alpha/t. Conditioning on the held environment and averaging the gradient sample gives Q(g)=(1+(1−g)^2)/2. With independent gradients over time the cached law therefore averages Q(g)^k, whereas fresh environments average Q(g) before the kth power. Summing the two coordinate squares requires no coordinate independence and includes k=0 and zero initial coordinates. Only alpha/t can reach 2, giving the cached boundary rho=alpha/(2−alpha) with residual weight 1/4 there. For alpha=1/2 the refreshed factor is (s²−4s+24)/32 with s=t+1/t>2; monotonicity on t in (0,1) yields the stated unique cutoff and its equality/divergence cases. Independently, at rho=1/4, alpha=1/2 the exact Q-values are 5/8, 181/200, 13/8, with fresh weighted average 189/200. The cached divergence is consistent with decaying conditional means since the mean multipliers 1−g/2 have modulus below one. This is conditional mean decay, not an absolute first-moment or almost-sure claim.
residual_risks: The result applies only to the stated ideal exact two-example scheme. It does not analyze arbitrary periodic refresh intervals, finite-precision sketching or an approximate spectral estimate.

evidence: The indexed Gaussian IHS refresh-run record studies x_(t+1)=(1−eta/W_t)x_t with inverse chi-square curvature factors. At sketch dimension 6 and eta=1/3, always refreshing has squared-factor mean 1/4 while partial reuse leads to an infinite moment by step two.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Cache versus refresh can be expressed as averaging powers versus powering averages of a random contraction/amplification factor. The Gaussian IHS laws involve continuous inverse-sketch tails, exact gradients and a deterministic step, not a four-environment gain distribution arising from a distinct random spectral step and gradient batch. The qualitative phenomenon overlaps, not the sharp finite-moment theorem.

checked_sources: Exact rational witness and phase boundaries
value.rationale: The two-coordinate interpolating system isolates a specific pitfall of the existing spectral-step design: perfect conditioning of the full Hessian and decaying mean iterates do not preclude mean-square divergence when both sampled quantities are reused. The exact nonempty stability gap supplies a useful counterexample and quantitative boundary for the prescribed comparison, rather than an arbitrary finite table.
residual_risks: The phenomenon does not establish failure for production batch sizes, finite spectral estimates, other preconditioners or general least-squares data.
